First release of **get-found** — an Agent Skill and Claude Code plugin that makes a website findable by Google, Bing and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot) and keeps it that way.

**Modes:** `setup` · `check` · `sync` · `post` · `report`

**Highlights**
- 16-item ledger in your repo (`.get-found/`) tracking status, last checked, next due and evidence
- Crawler audit: sitemap, robots.txt, canonicals, titles, OG/preview images, structured data, client-rendered pages, AI bot access (RFC 9309 matrix for 30+ bots)
- Change detection for new / changed / removed pages, IndexNow pings, Search Console and Bing Webmaster API helpers
- Live-docs sync: re-checks ~55 official pages and changelogs every run; changes become project overrides
- Keyword map, weekly post workflow, directory listings by site type and country, monthly report template

**Install**
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add MohsinMMK/get-found` then `/plugin install get-found@get-found`
- Claude.ai: download `get-found.zip` below → Customize → Skills → upload

Rules verified against official documentation on 2026-11-02.
